brief:
Two young Palestinian men were shot and injured during an Israeli military raid on Jericho on Friday night, Wafa news agency reported. The incident occurred as tensions in the West Bank remain high.

The shooting coincided with reports of Palestinian farmers being prevented from accessing olive groves during the harvest season, a recurring obstacle to agricultural work in occupied territories.
dek: West Bank: Two Palestinians shot, farmers blocked from olive harvest Two young Palestinian men were shot at and injured during an Israeli military raid on the city of Jericho on Friday night, Wafa news agency reported.
title: Israeli military shoots two Palestinians in Jericho raid
